propositions: The tag [operator-attested] must be renamed to [non-codebase] to reflect that the evidence location (outside codebase) is the relevant axis, not who attests it
[operator-attested] must remain as an undocumented but accepted compatibility alias because 827 of 4285 live event-sourced tickets carry it and cannot be mutated
The deterministic matcher regex must be widened to non-capturing alternation (?:non-codebase|operator-attested) so findall() arity is unchanged and both spellings produce identical outcomes
The reader-side code in audit/page.py:329 must be widened before emitter-side changes so legacy verdicts with kind='operator-attested' continue rendering
The activation trigger in .rebar/criteria_routing.json must be widened so [non-codebase]-tagged plans fire project.measurement-provenance
Author-facing documentation and prompts must emit [non-codebase] only while recognition-side prompts instruct that both spellings are recognized
